Name: Seasonal Toned Down Craftables
Author: twilightdvsn
Description:
This mod adds 4 variants of craftables, one for each season. The summer one is the same as their regular version.

They are less saturated and curated to their respective season.

I know you might not use all of these outside, so you have the option for each craftable to just use the regular toned down version without the seasonal overlay or to not use it at all.

Works with GMCM, has the following options for each craftable: seasonal, regular, disabled. 

I did not do everything on the craftables tilesheet, so if anyone wants something added just leave a comment and I'll put it on my to-do list :)
